pred_ddx.label: Adrenal adenoma or other adrenal pathology

Testicular cancer: The patient presents with painless right testicular swelling, enlargement and inhomogeneity of the right testis and epididymis on ultrasound, and intense uptake on 18 FDG PET/CT, all of which are consistent with testicular cancer. Additionally, the testicular ultrasound findings and intense uptake on PET/CT are key diagnostic features for this condition.
Adrenal adenoma or other adrenal patholo: The patient has new bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement with homogeneous attenuation on CT and absence of uptake on 18 FDG PET/CT, which are characteristic of adrenal adenoma or other adrenal pathology. The normal electrolytes and blood pressure also support this diagnosis, as adrenal adenomas are often non-functioning.
